traits.name: Glittering Distraction
traits.text: ⬻ (emotion, mental); The tax collector Strides. At any point during this movement, they can Interact to hurl coins. If there are commoners about, this typically causes a scene. Crowds are usually difficult terrain and have other effects (Core Rulebook 514).
